notes.text: A handwritten working sheet arranges cyclic border pairings for V₁,V₂,V₃ and Γ′₁,Γ′₂,Γ′₃, with Γ″ᵢ placed above Γ′ᵢ−∂ and the definition ∂={x?,y}. It adds three union chains, a sideways three-arc drawing, the compartmented U₃ relation, dotted U₃=Γ₃, and the unfinished U₃∪. There is no date, title, authorial page number or written self-doubt sentence; the lower-left pencil 2 is archival numbering.

The first chain ends visibly in Γ″₁∪Γ″₂∪∂. Under the local interpretation that every primed arc contains the two endpoints, the preceding likely Γ′₂∪Γ′₃ would expand to Γ″₂∪Γ″₃∪∂. This conditional substitution check prompted a close reading: the final indices really are 1,2, while the earlier primed index remains 2|1. No repair is made. The first left index is 1 on its rising entry, upright and two-sided foot, against R1’s uncertain 2|1.

All three initial unprimed relations are preserved without adding primes. As set equalities Γ₁=Γ₂∪Γ₃, Γ₂=Γ₃∪Γ₁ and Γ₃=Γ₁∪Γ₂ would force Γ₁=Γ₂=Γ₃ by mutual inclusion. This is only a consequence check; the page does not supply enough definitions to prove or refute the intended topological assertions. The row-2 terminal mark remains ∂|dotted ∂ on the ink, and the side superscript is a cancelled circlet, not H’s live star.

The drawing’s right outer label is Γ′₂. The live small x-like label remains uncertain at its first occurrence in the endpoint set; the separate cancelled mark inside the loop remains x|∂. Four oblique strokes, two dotted returns, the local contour retraces and the quarter-turn are reproduced in TikZ. The unfinished union is kept unfinished, and the detached mark before U,C,V remains explicitly doubtful.
